def max_chocolates(n, a, b, p, q):
    # Calculate the number of tiles divisible by a, b, and both a and b
    count_a = n // a
    count_b = n // b
    count_ab = n // (a * b)
    
    # Calculate the maximum chocolates by choosing the better option for each tile
    max_choco = (count_a - count_ab) * p + (count_b - count_ab) * q
    
    return max_choco
